title: Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
description: Jesus meets a Samaritan woman at Jacob's Well in Sychar and offers her living water. He reveals her life, discusses true worship, and reveals himself as the Messiah. Many Samaritans come to faith.

versions.title: Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
versions.description: Jesus meets a Samaritan woman at the well and offers her living water.
